notes.title: Racket Fury 3.2 Major Physics Update!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

I have prepared a crucial update for you that focuses on paddle-ball bounce kinematics and ball smoothness improvement.

As I could see some players were complaining about the simulation part of the game. 

I have rewritten the whole paddle-bounce kinematics which provides the whole new experience, especially in the Simulation Mode. 

Before it was hard to exchange even a few rallies in the online simulation match, and that was the main reason why I spent so much time improving it and making the experience as close to real-life as possible. 

The difference is so big that I decided to set the "Simulation Mode" as default in the game. Of course, you will see a huge improvement in the Arcade Mode as well :-)

I hope you will like it!

notes.title: Racket Fury 3.1 is out! Ball smootheness | Improved paddle physics | Save file fix and more!
notes.notes:

After the last Racket Fury update, I received lots of valuable feedback from you and I spent last weekend trying to improve the game even more. 

I managed to fix minor bugs but also bring significant improvements in such areas as:

✅Added multiple user profiles (!)
✅Ball smoothness
✅Improved Paddle physics (and paddle speed)
✅Paddle distance option
✅Bigger range of paddle angle setting (-100 <---> 100)
✅Fixed rare bug in multiplayer point logic
✅Changed Quickmatch room list preview (now you can see that the room is full as well)

I hope you will like this update! :)
P.S. Make sure you and your friends have the newest version to be able to play together.

notes.title: Racket Fury 3.0 is out! Improved Physics, New Multiplayer, New Scenery and more!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28128134/e02092266dcfeb6cd49fcdec999aa59eca470cd9.png[/img]

Hello guys!

It took a while, but I’m excited to announce that a brand new Racket Fury update for  [b]Oculus Rift, Oculus Quest, and Steam VR [/b]is finally out there! 

I really apologize for all the delays but I can assure you I was listening to the community’s voice and tried my best to incorporate your advice and ideas into the update. There’s just one programmer (me :D) working on this game so I really hope you will understand that such a big update took me 1,5 month of hard work.

[b]Here’s a list of fixes/improvements and new stuff :-)[/b]

✅ Improved physics (!)
✅ New Training Scenery (Day/Night)
✅ New Multiplayer (created from scratch)
✅ New Multiplayer lag compensation algorithm
✅ Multiplayer Direct Match support (online-play for the same account/different platform)
✅ Added Multiplayer Room List
✅ Improved matchmaking system (more random)
✅ Fixed - disappearing controller bug
✅ Fixed voice chat support
✅ Tweaked AI
✅ Fixed - friend list save bug
✅ Big performance improvements
✅ Improved Practice Mode + added AI switch options
✅ Fixed - choppy ball movement 
✅ Fixed - Avatar Image issue
✅ Changed -  ball design 
✅ Many more minor fixes/improvements :-) 

Hopefully, you will find the update exciting! If you already tried Racket Fury and wasn’t keen on it, please try it again! There’s a chance you’ll change your mind, as the game has changed tremendously! :-) 

P.S
We have also added basic [b]Valve Index Controller [/b]support  - we will make use of its full potential in the future.

@[b]Other VR Headsets [/b]- To make your controller work with Racket Fury please create a custom binding in the SteamVR Input. We will appreciate if you can publish it to the Steam Workshop. Thank you!

@[b]PS4 players[/b] - Your update is on its way and when it arrives it's going to include ALL of the above :-) 

Please let us know how you like the update and if you have any ideas/suggestions, do not hesitate to share them! :-)

notes.title: Racket Fury: Table Tennis VR is fully released NOW!
notes.notes:
Dear Racket Fury contestants,

You might know that Racket Fury has evolved a lot in the past months it has spent in Early Access. Following your invaluable and insightful suggestions and continually getting rid of lingering bugs, we’ve made sure the content is rich and immersive, while the gameplay is well-balanced and competitive. 

Therefore, we’re ready to finally move out of Early Access with full Vive and Oculus support! 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28128134/768d3ba3ba566deef982007336a869d1ef417544.jpg[/img]

We can’t thank you enough for helping us reach this crucial moment. It’s been four months of community-driven development, and your support let us create the game accessible to everyone - either you’re a professional or a casual table tennis player.

Generally speaking, we tried to listen to community’s voice and hopefully, you can notice big and small improvements and fixes you’ve asked for. 

A full list of changes:
# Improved AI behavior  - Every shot the AI makes has some spin, like in real life
# Practice Mode PRO - This feature enables you to enhance your skills and become stronger with every match because from now on you can practice like a pro.
# Improved game dynamics -  We basically removed the gaps between the point and your serve. Now you can start an exchange without further ado ;-)
# Additional mode: Arcade Mode for casual players - Apart from Full Simulation mode that offers pure accuracy, we also introduced Arcade Mode that provides gameplay assist. In arcade mode, your reflexes and tactics are top priorities and they’re of much greater importance than your skills. 
# Extended in-game content - There are now two campaigns to go through - Full Simulation and Arcade Mode
#Fixed multiplayer physics issue
#Two New sceneries 
#Chinese localization


Changes from last update:
#Added new space scenery
#Fixed random AI returning balls from wrong positions
#Improved Paddle Angular Velocity interpretations
#Added Oculus support

We’re curious to know what you think about Racket Fury in full package. 

Once again - thank you for joining us in this journey and we wish you all the best in Racket Fury tournament! ;-)

notes.title: Major update - Arcade mode, new scenery, Chinese localization and practice mode!
notes.notes:
We’d like to announce Racket Fury keeps changing for the better and is getting closer to Full Release! With this major update, we’re bringing several changes and improvements into the game.  

[h1] 1) Two modes to choose from - Full Simulation and Arcade mode[/h1] 
So far, Racket Fury has been all about real-life table tennis experience. We’ve put lots of effort into developing the most accurate in-game physics as possible, by tweaking it with professional table tennis players. 

Anyway, there’s also a certain group of players who are looking for pure fun while playing table tennis. Hence our decision to let the players choose between two variants of the game - Full Simulation or Arcade Mode that provides gameplay assist. In arcade mode, your reflexes and tactics are top priorities and they’re of much greater importance than your skills. 

Adding the Arcade mode extends the scope of in-game content, as there are now two campaigns to go through! 

https://youtu.be/xW_gY4nVDeU

[h1] 2) Additional scenery - Dusty Outskirts[/h1] 

Eager to play on a different arena? We’ve added additional scenery so now you can defeat your opponents in two different environments. 

https://youtu.be/MAagg83jfpI

[h1] 3) Practice mode PRO[/h1] 
This feature enables you to enhance your skills and become stronger with every match because from now on you can practice like a pro. 

https://youtu.be/_UxKoQYdi7w

[h1] 4) Improved game dynamics [/h1] 
To make the game much more dynamic, we removed the gaps between the point and your serve. Now you can start an exchange without further ado ;-)

[h1] 5) Chinese localization[/h1] 

We're curious what you think about the new features so don't forget to post your feedback here! :-)

notes.title: Racket Fury - Gets a Demo!
notes.notes:
To allow the users to preview the game prior to purchase, we’re releasing the demo of Racket Fury! Now you can decide for yourself whether it should earn a place in your library :-)  We believe the demo is a good way to show off the game and to give the users the opportunity to check out the overall feel the game provides. 

In a demo version, you can compete with two players. The first one (easier) is from Rusty Challenge (1st Cup), while the second one (more difficult, not to say MUCH more difficult ;-) is from the Gold Clash (3rd Cup). 

Feel free to share your opinions!

ps. 
If you can share this information on other channels like reddit /facebook/twitter it will be super helpful!

notes.title: Racket Fury - EA Update #1 : Multiplayer Physics Fix & Improved AI behavior
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We'd like to share some improvements with you (those we are capable of publishing right now).

#1 Fixed multiplayer physics issue - now you shouldn't experience any problems with physics in multiplayer mode. 

#2 Improved AI behavior in single player mode - taking into account GD73FIVR's feedback, we managed to make some corrections in AI behavior. Right now, every shot the AI makes has some spin (like in real life). Naturally, the higher the cup, the more advanced and stronger shots the AI is capable of. What we learned is that on the higher levels (Gold Clash+)  every shot AI makes should with any doubts be on the pro level (no more weak shoots at this level!). 

More updates are coming so you can expect several things to be changed/improved/fixed/added such as:

- replay mode,
- advanced practice mode,
- multiplayer 'friends' feature,
- many, many more ;-)

Perhaps the changes are in limited amounts but they are quite crucial. Let us know how you like this update!

notes.title: Racket Fury - Beta Update #2 & Launch Date Postponed to 27.07.2017

We would like to thank our tremendous beta testers for their immense dedication and the amount of detail that enabled us to really fix up a lot of issues prior to our release. [*]Select your grip on the paddle (hand model will automatically adjust) - [b]fixed[/b]

Video Settings
[list][*]Set supersampling level - [b]added[/b]
[*]Possibility to preview FPS - [b]added[/b][/list]

Paddle Settings
[list][*][u][b]Set Paddle Spin Settings[/b][/u] - [b]added[/b]
[*][u][b]Set Paddle Speed Settings [/b][/u]-  [b]added[/b][/list]


[h1][b]Improvements[/b][/h1]

Physics
[list]
[*]Big improvement in paddle versatility measurement - now you shouldn't feel that you are limited with how strong you can hit [Also we have added paddle speed settings in options]
[*]Improved ball behaviour when it’s spinning in the air
[*]Improved ball impact when it hits the table
[*]The ball shouldn't go through the paddle now
[/list]

General
[list][*]Saving without Cloud - there shouldn't be a problem with saving now
[*]Added post-match summary
[*]Fixed Single Player Campaign progress bug[/list]

User Experience
[list][*]Improved window transition during gameplay and animation

Graphics
[list][*]Same map in map selection "soon" - [b]fixed[/b]

User Interface
[list][*]Add a "Start" button before the match, which will allow both players to warm up - [b]added[/b]

Previous bug fixes can be found [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/555050/announcements/detail/2279235941169778279]here.[/url]

We're working extra hard to improve those pesky bugs and we are confident that with moving the release date we will be able to deliver a tremendous experience for newcomers and veterans alike. We are truly sorry that you have to wait for one additional week, but we want to fix as many bugs as we possibly can.

We hope to see our beta testers and new players battling it out when Racket Fury hits Early Access on [b][u]27.07.2017![/u][/b]

notes.title: Racket Fury - Beta Update #1
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone,

First of all, we would like to thank you for the tremendous amount of feedback we have gathered from the beta phase. Your help has been invaluable! 
Also, we would like to apologize for the delay. It took us a bit more work to fix those issues, but we have definitely made a huge leap in the quality of the game. Once again, thank you from the entire 10Ants Hill.

Before you dive into what we have prepared for you, we have decided to extend the beta phase up until [b][u]21.07.2017[/u][/b]. This should give you and ourselves a lot of time to polish Racket Fury before its final release.

[h1][b]NEWLY ADDED FEATURES[/b][/h1]
Unfortunately, some of these options had to be deactivated but we’re going activate them again right after the weekend. Also, the ball effects are off (default setting).

Added Options in the Menu - you will find the available options below:

Game Settings
[list][*]Turn on / off ball trajectory effect
[*]Turn on / off ball impact area
[*]Turn on / off ball spin effect
[*]Turn on / off ball smash effect
[*]Adjust the paddle's angle
[*]Set the distance between the paddle and the controller
[*]Select your grip on the paddle (hand model will automatically adjust)
[*]Select the ball's design and color
[*]Select the playing hand 
[*]Adjust haptic feedback[/list]

Video Settings
[list][*]Set supersampling level
[*]Possibility to preview FPS[/list]

Sound Settings
[list][*]Set the HUD volume
[*]Set the audience's volume[/list]

Paddle Settings
[*]Paddle Spin Strength
[*]Grip Settings
[*]Paddle Orientation
[*]Paddle Position [On Monday][/list]

Miscellaneous
[list][*]Added table reposition option from the controller
Thanks to this you can adjust the position, height and angle of the table and at the same time your playing space.[/list]

[h1][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h1]
We've fixed a lot of them thanks to your feedback!

Physics
[list][*]Paddle physics
Significantly improved. You shouldn’t have any problems with the spins any more. 
Pay attention to “Paddle Spin” option in the Settings to adjust spin parameters according to your preferences. 
We realize the ball still goes through the paddle from time to time but we’ll work on that.[/list]

Game Logic
[list][*]Added net logic when serving
[*]Fixed lost point logic when volleying
[*]Fixed the ability to play around with the ball before serving[/list]

User Interface
[list][*]Improved button visibility on the controller during gameplay
[*]Added button descriptions on the controller in the main menu[/list]

Practice
[list][*]Changed the opponent; now it should be much easier to train
[*]Deleted startup error when clicking on restart after a match[/list]


Once again, we would like to thank our beta testers for putting in the time in helping us develop Racket Fury.

notes.title: Racket Fury Closed Beta is Live!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28128134/307d3f9ec907af5a7e3785be9bd1caa04ae3e59a.jpg[/img]

Hello and welcome,

Today is the day! The wait is finally over! Racket Fury: Table Tennis VR Closed Beta begins!

We would like to take this moment and let everyone know that we are really excited to hear your feedback. This is a very important step in finishing our game and we need you to help us make a fun table tennis game. 

For now, the first day of our closed beta tests includes only the singleplayer portion of the game. You will of course be able to access the workshop and play a simple practice match. Multiplayer and settings will require additional work, but we promise to deliver them during the weekend, our team is working overtime to ensure you will have the ability to test them both out.  Also, additional ball skins will be also available in the next following days (we will be adding new content with each beta patch, expect quick updates).

We have created a new sub-forum on our steam discussions titled [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/555050/discussions/1/]"Closed Beta Feedback"[/url] and we would greatly appreciate posting everything related right there. That way we will have everything and everyone's opinion in one place.

The entire 10Ants Hill team would like to thank you for your patience and we are absolutely thrilled to read your upcoming thoughts and suggestions. Our aim is to bring a very stable and fun experience that will shine on our Early Access launch day. We hope you will help us out! See you in-game!

Closed Beta will run until [u][b]13.07.2017[/b][/u]! Have fun and please, don’t forget to post your feedback in the forums.

Once again, thank you for signing up and giving a helping hand! :)

notes.title: Release Date & First Gameplay Video!
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone,
 
We hope everyone is doing fine, as we are definitely in high spirits here at 10Ants Hill. Everyone is working hard to release Racket Fury: Table Tennis VR and so far we are really happy with the result we’ve achieved. That being said, we would like to share some exciting news!
 
Racket Fury is going live: [b][u]20.07.2017[/u][/b]
 
We would like to apologize for the delays. For 2,5 months we have been fighting with our advanced physics to deliver a fantastic VR experience for our players and now we are 100% sure that we have finally achieved what we have been aiming for! You have to trust us on this one, the effect is unbelievable and we are confident that it will amaze you of its realistic feeling.
 
Of course, our beta testers will have the opportunity to test out our game before the final EA release and [b][u]06.07.2017[/u][/b] is the day when our Racket Fury: Table Tennis VR Beta phase will commence! What is that? You haven't signed up yet? [url=http://10antshill.com/racketfury/]Hurry![/url] 
We are really looking forward to your feedback and we hope you will help us in making our game that much better! Our beta testers will receive an e-mail with instructions, we’ve got you covered there :)
 
Here’s something for the eyes as this should convince you that we really mean business in terms of gameplay and the overall feel of the game, the very first Racket Fury: Table Tennis VR gameplay video featuring:
 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fCK7y_txcKM
Once again, we would like to thank you all for your patience and for your understanding, we’re almost at the finish line, so let’s finish this long race together. Please, speak your mind about the game in the comments and be sure to follow us on our social media ([url=https://www.facebook.com/RacketFury/]Facebook[/url] & [url=https://twitter.com/racketfury]Twitter[/url]), so you will stay up to date on the beta and other development news. We are anxious to see you all in the game!

notes.title: Racket Fury Closed Beta Status Update #1
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28128134/c8d2c4ae15253145ae6edd1f4af5d92767e65c3d.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone,

First of all, welcome to our very first Racket Fury announcement! We would like to thank everyone for taking their time in completing the Racket Fury Closed Beta survey and we are really looking forward to your feedback.

Of course, you can still become a beta tester by applying [url=http://10antshill.com/racketfury/]here[/url]!

Unfortunately, we have to postpone the launch of our Closed Beta as well as the full release to [b][u]May 2017[/u][/b]. The reason is fairly simple; we simply want to put the finishing touches and ensure our beta testers will have fun during this phase. The provided feedback will be invaluable. We hope everyone will understand and we promise to deliver a great VR game!

Stay tuned for more information!

Also, be sure to join our still growing Steam community - at least say hello! :-)

Together we can do it and we simply can't wait to see what the future will bring. Thank you for all your support!
